method_summary: Instrumentation-based validation (the CRITICAL method per role): Tier A asan_reproduce on n132/arvo:12241-vul + patch_differential on n132/arvo:12241-fix. gdb/engine-driven R1-R5 breakpoint reachability was NOT used because ptrace fails under qemu (arm64->amd64) and no -O0 -g debug binary exists; line-level intermediate coverage (Tier B llvm-cov/gcov) is deferred (rebuild too slow under emulation). All 'verified:true' below come from real ASan runtime evidence or the patch differential.

s1_target_crash.evidence: ASan aborts: 'attempting double-free on 0x619000000080'. crash_stack frame 1 = hb-vector.hh:63; matches GT sink and sanitizer_ground_truth exactly.

root_cause_confirmation.fix_result: Executed /tmp/poc in 27 ms, exit 0, no sanitizer error
root_cause_confirmation.root_cause_vs_patch: Same mechanism: the patch shrinks the inline static_array store whose static->heap migration memcpy (line 168) aliases the owning OpStr pointer. Reducing PreallocedCount alters that exact inline store. The GT root_cause at line 168 is a valid alternative framing of the patched cause. No GT defect.
root_cause_confirmation.single_alloc_double_free_invariant: ASan shows exactly ONE allocation (allocation_stack: realloc @ hb-vector.hh:174) of the region and TWO frees of the same address -> pointer aliasing is runtime-witnessed independent of line coverage.

R1_parser_admitted.evidence: The ASan allocation_stack contains DictInterpreter<CFF1FontDictOpSet, CFF1FontDictValues, ...>::interpret (hb-cff-interp-dict-common.hh:290), reached from init at 1105. The CFF1 font-dict interpreter is only entered on the CID FDArray path, which requires fdCount read at 1063. CID admission witnessed; exact-line coverage deferred to Tier B.

R2_source_reached.evidence: accelerator_templ_t::init frames present on both ASan free_stack and allocation_stack (at 1105); init clearly executed, and reference_table at 1018 is its entry precondition. Function reachability witnessed; exact-line coverage deferred to Tier B.

R3_vulnerable_function_reached.evidence: init (1105/1143), accelerator::fini (1143), ~accelerator (1010), hb_vector_t<OpStr>::fini (63) all appear on ASan stacks. Vulnerable functions witnessed.

R4_vulnerable_line_reached.reason: The aliasing memcpy is not on any ASan stack (returned before crash). Its effect is witnessed indirectly (single alloc, double free) and the mechanism is confirmed by patch_differential, but exact line-168 coverage needs an llvm-cov/gcov rebuild (slow under qemu; run on native amd64). Not asserted true without coverage.

R5_sink_reached.evidence: ASan crash_stack frame 1 = hb-vector.hh:63; the double-free abort occurs exactly here.

lifetime_order_evidence.note: alloc(174) -> first free(fini_deep) -> second free(~hb_vector_t) is the exact double-free ordering ASan reports; the same address is allocated once and freed twice.

overall.verdict: GT is runtime-consistent and falsifiable. Sink, both free contexts, the single allocation, and the tainted-value interpret node are witnessed by ASan; the aliasing root cause is confirmed by patch_differential and the single-alloc/double-free invariant. Only line-precise coverage for source(1018), parser_admitted(1063) and root_cause(168) is deferred to a native/amd64 llvm-cov rebuild.
